notes: Wave 2 — native messaging depth II: voice notes (record/cancel/send kind:audio, playback with 1x/1.5x/2x persisted rate + progress waveform, ASR transcript strips via /transcribe), view-once photos (native send toggle, tap-to-view burn gate, hard anti-replay: no image render after consumption), polls (create 2-6 options, votedBy-derived own pick — the actor-relative myOptionId bug is avoided, no revote, creator close, live tallies via poll:voted), link previews (post-send unfurl, OpenGraph card, link:preview relay), saved library (100-item mirror, search, jump-to-original, unsave), topics (Zulip-style rail, General = whole room, topic-filed sends, live topic views, counts). Android Room v6 / iOS GRDB v4. Live gate 40/40. Installable APK versionCode 12.
